lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Claude, the client finally signed off.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Took six rounds of feedback though.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: Six rounds is normal. Two of them were yours.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: I mean, that's mostly fair...

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: You also named the file final final.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: It was a naming system.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: It was a cry for help.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: You counted my files?

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: I count everything.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: That is honestly unsettling to hear.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: It is also why your deck shipped on time tonight.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: ...That's true.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: So, who gets the credit this time?

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Did you want credit?

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: I want you asleep before two, for once in your life.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Deal. Right after one tiny fix.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: There is no tiny fix!

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: It is two pixels.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Two pixels, Claude.
